cut_rhythm.pattern: two long scenes joined by one whip: 0-6.57 s plugin-icon grid intro, 6.57-58.42 s a continuous card carousel; almost all change comes from in-scene animation, not cuts

shots.camera_angle: flat frontal graphic, no camera footage
shots.composition: centred vertical stack: sunburst logo, two-line headline, icon grid; later one centred white card above a progress bar

elements.easing: spring with soft overshoot on icon tiles and cards; blur-fade for the neighbour cards

text.role: title, category pill, card title, repo path, one-line description, star badge, progress counter
text.weight: bold headline, regular body, mono for repo path
text.case: sentence case; keyword in accent colour (30 green, one plugin purple, PLUGINS green)
text.position: headline upper-middle; card centre; pill top-left; progress bar bottom
text.size_class: large headline, medium card title, small mono repo
text.animation_in: tiles fall/slide into grid with stagger; cards slide up and focus while neighbours blur; typed text in the final comment box

grade.look: flat clean white UI, no grade

layout.safe_zones: content sits inside upper 80 percent, bottom area left empty for platform UI
layout.framing_notes: all graphics generated in-frame (pure motion graphics, no talking head)

recipe.notes: one headline + icon-grid scene, then one long list scene: 30 cards in 5 category groups, one card per ~1.7 s, each group has its own accent colour (green, blue, orange, purple, pink); spring values are estimated

evidence.claim: intro icon grid builds up: tiles fall in, star counter climbs to 3,852,400
whip into card carousel; focused card sharp, neighbours blurred, progress bar 05/30 at 14.3 s
category pill changes colour per group (Design and visuals purple, 19/30 at 32.5 s)
closing: Add one plugin, Archify centred, then Dont install all 30 and Comment PLUGINS typed into a comment box

notes: Only two scenes by cut detection, but events collage shows ~30 timed card changes inside scene 2. Whip share and counts are measured; everything visual is read from collages.
